description: MCP tool reference for SignalK server - Code Execution Mode

execution_mode.description: The SignalK MCP server uses V8 isolate code execution by default. This provides 90-96% token savings compared to legacy tools.

primary_tool.name: execute_code
primary_tool.description: Execute JavaScript code in a secure V8 isolate with access to SignalK SDK functions

code_requirements: ALL SDK functions are async and MUST be awaited
Console.log output is captured in 'logs' array

sdk_functions.note: ALL functions are async and MUST be awaited, including getConnectionStatus()

getVesselState.description: Get comprehensive vessel data (position, heading, speed, identity, sensors)
getVesselState.returns: Object with 'data' property containing all SignalK paths as keys

getAisTargets.description: Get nearby AIS targets sorted by distance (closest first)

parameters.maxDistance: Filter by max distance in meters (optional)

getAisTargets.returns: Object with 'targets' array containing vessels with MMSI, position, distance
getAisTargets.example:
const ais = await getAisTargets({ pageSize: 50, maxDistance: 5000 });
const nearby = ais.targets.filter(t => t.distanceMeters < 1852);

getActiveAlarms.description: Get all system notifications and alerts (including resolved)
getActiveAlarms.returns: Object with 'alarms' array containing path, state, message, timestamp
getActiveAlarms.example:
const alarms = await getActiveAlarms();
const critical = alarms.alarms.filter(a => a.state === 'alarm');

listAvailablePaths.description: Discover all available SignalK data paths on the server
listAvailablePaths.returns: Object with 'paths' array of available path strings
listAvailablePaths.example:
const result = await listAvailablePaths();
const navPaths = result.paths.filter(p => p.startsWith('navigation.'));

getPathValue.description: Get latest value for a specific SignalK path

parameters.path: SignalK path as string OR {path: string} object

getPathValue.returns: Object with 'data' property containing value, timestamp, source
getPathValue.example:
const speed = await getPathValue('navigation.speedOverGround');
const heading = await getPathValue({ path: 'navigation.headingTrue' });

getConnectionStatus.description: Get SignalK connection status and server configuration
getConnectionStatus.note: This function is also async - MUST use await
getConnectionStatus.returns: Object with connected, url, hostname, port, context, timestamp
getConnectionStatus.example:
const status = await getConnectionStatus();
console.log('Connected:', status.connected);

getHistory.signature: await getHistory({ paths, from, to, duration, resolution, aggregate, context })
getHistory.description: Query aggregated historical time-series for one or more SignalK paths. Requires a SignalK history provider (e.g. signalk-to-influxdb).

parameters.paths: Path string or array of paths; add an inline aggregation method as path:method[:param], e.g. 'navigation.speedOverGround:sma:5'
parameters.duration: ISO-8601 duration (PT1H) or seconds; use instead of 'from'
parameters.resolution: Bucket size in SECONDS (not milliseconds), e.g. 60 for 1-minute buckets
parameters.aggregate: Default method for bare paths: average|min|max|first|last (default average)

getHistory.returns: { available, values: { '<path>': [{ timestamp, value }] }, series, missingPaths, rowCount }. Check 'available' (false = no history provider). null marks a data gap. navigation.position values are [longitude, latitude] ARRAYS, unlike live getVesselState which uses {latitude, longitude}.

listHistoryPaths.description: List SignalK paths that have historical data in a time window. Defaults to the last 24 hours.
listHistoryPaths.returns: { available, count, paths: string[] }. available:false means no history provider.
listHistoryPaths.example:
const h = await listHistoryPaths();
if (h.available) console.log(h.paths.length, 'historized paths');

listHistoryContexts.description: List vessel contexts that have historical data. Call before get_history to discover which vessels have history.
listHistoryContexts.example:
const h = await listHistoryContexts();
if (h.available) console.log(h.contexts);

getCourseStatus.description: Current navigation course: active route/destination plus calculated values (cross-track error, bearing, ETA, VMG, time-to-go). Values are SI (distance in metres, bearings in radians).
getCourseStatus.returns: { available, navigating, course, calcValues }. navigating is false (and calcValues null) when no destination is set. available:false means the course API is unavailable.

utility_tools.description: Available in all execution modes for debugging and documentation

get_connection_status.purpose: Check SignalK server connectivity (MCP tool, not SDK)

get_initial_context.purpose: Get comprehensive SignalK documentation and context
get_initial_context.use_when: Starting a new session to understand available data

initial_discovery: Use execute_code with getConnectionStatus() to verify connectivity
Use execute_code with listAvailablePaths() to understand capabilities
Use execute_code with getVesselState() filtered for overview
ongoing_monitoring: Use execute_code with getPathValue() for specific data points
Use execute_code with getAisTargets() for traffic awareness
Filter data in isolate before returning to save tokens
troubleshooting: Use get_connection_status MCP tool for basic connectivity
Use execute_code with getActiveAlarms() filtered for critical only
Use execute_code with getPathValue() for specific diagnostics

efficiency_guidelines.filter_in_isolate: Always filter/transform data in the isolate before returning
efficiency_guidelines.combine_calls: Make multiple SDK calls in a single execute_code invocation
efficiency_guidelines.return_minimal: Only return the specific data needed, not entire objects
efficiency_guidelines.use_json_stringify: Always return JSON.stringify() of your result

token_savings.description: Code execution provides massive token savings vs legacy tools

data_interpretation.units: All SignalK values use SI units (meters, seconds, Kelvin, radians)
data_interpretation.timestamps: All data includes RFC 3339 timestamps for freshness checking
data_interpretation.missing_data: Paths may not exist if sensors/systems not installed
data_interpretation.null_values: Null values indicate sensor offline or no valid reading
data_interpretation.history_times: History query times are ISO-8601 only; resolution is in SECONDS (not milliseconds)
data_interpretation.history_positions: In history results, navigation.position is a [longitude, latitude] array - NOT the {latitude, longitude} object that live getVesselState/getPathValue return
data_interpretation.history_gaps: In history results, null marks a time bucket with no data - filter nulls before averaging or integrating
data_interpretation.history_availability: get_history/list_history_* return available:false when the SignalK server has no history provider installed

legacy_tools.status: DEPRECATED - Available only in 'tools' or 'hybrid' mode
legacy_tools.note: Use execute_code with SDK functions instead for 90-96% token savings
